deities: Lord Shiva as Aghanjar Mahadev ('Aghanjar' = destroyer of sins)
Gupteshwar Mahadev (shivlinga hidden under a huge rock, a few stairs away)

history.period: Believed ~500 years old per local and tourism accounts (unverified); legend places its origin in the Mahabharata era
history.summary: Aghanjar Mahadev Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, stands in the forests of Khaniyara village at the Dhauladhar foothills. Legend says Arjuna of the Mahabharata did penance here en route to Kailash and Shiva blessed him (with victory/Pashupatastra); 'Aghanjar' means destroyer of sins. A few stairs away is the Gupteshwar Mahadev shrine, a shivlinga hidden ('gupt') under a huge rock, and a small cave with a shivlinga and a waterfall sit nearby. Accounts also tell of Baba Ganga Bharti, a saint of Maharaja Ranjit Singh's era (early 19th century), whose dhuni (sacred fire) is said to have burned here for 600 years - a conflict, since Ranjit Singh's rule is ~200 years old; other accounts say the flame burns 100+ years (conflict - verify). The temple sits beside a stream with a small waterfall, in dense deodar forest. FLAG: CSV town 'Dharamshala' is approximate; the temple is at Khaniyara village, ~5-9 km from Dharamshala (sources conflict: Holidify says 5 km, Tripadvisor reviews say 9 km - verify).

name: Aghanjar Mahadev Temple
town_description: Khaniyara (Khanyara) is a village about 7-9 km from Dharamshala in Kangra district, at the foothills of the Dhauladhar range, known for its slate quarries and dense deodar forests.

travel.railway: Pathankot Junction, about 85 km, is the nearest major railhead.
travel.road: About 5-9 km from Dharamshala on the Sidhpur-Khaniyara road (15-30 minutes by taxi/auto); about 16 km from McLeod Ganj; ~50 stone steps lead up to the temple, with a stream and picnic spot below.

visitor_information.best_time: March to June and September to November; Maha Shivaratri (February/March) is the main festival.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM-8:00 PM per Tripadvisor listings; Holidify lists 5:00 AM-9:00 PM - verify before visiting. No entry fee.
